title: Ruflow launches 60 AI agents for powerful, efficient task #ruflow #aiteamwork #opensourceai
description: Ruflow launched a powerful Claw tool that runs 60+ AI agents simultaneously and integrates directly with Claw. It orchestrates teams of AI agents, with queen agents leading and technical agents executing tasks like research, coding, testing, and reviewing, all while sharing a collective memory that evolves over time. The tool optimizes task complexity by delegating simpler tasks to cheaper models and more demanding ones to powerful models, reducing token usage by up to 50% and extending cloud resource efficiency by up to 250%. Being open source and free, Ruflow exemplifies rapid innovation in AI orchestration and collaborative agent frameworks. This advancement highlights a significant shift in how multi-agent AI systems can operate efficiently at scale, promising major implications for software development, automation, and cloud cost management. #Ruflow #ClawTool #MultiAgentAI #OpenSourceAI #AIOrchestration #AIResearch #AIInnovation #CloudEfficiency #GitHubTopProject #AutomationTechnology #ArtificialIntelligence #TechInnovation #AIModels #TokenOptimization #SoftwareDevelopment
